items.text: Jurassic Park, directed by Steven Spielberg, was released in theaters on June 11, 1993.
items.question: Where did you see Jurassic Park, and who sat beside you?
items.source_quote: June 11 – Jurassic Park, directed by Steven Spielberg, is released in theaters as the first film in the Jurassic Park saga.

items.text: On June 20, 1993, John Paxson's 3-point shot in Game 6 of the NBA Finals helped the Chicago Bulls beat the Phoenix Suns for their third consecutive championship.
items.question: Who did you watch the Chicago Bulls with in those championship years, and where were you watching?
items.source_quote: June 20 – John Paxson's 3-point shot in Game 6 of the NBA Finals helps the Chicago Bulls secure a 99–98 win over the Phoenix Suns, and their third consecutive championship.
